name: Erasion raises the Anomaly Spikes chance and Anomaly Spike damage (#695)
contract: Erasion 704489's tooltip reads "Increases the chance to trigger Anomaly Spikes by $s1% and their damage by $s2%." In Spell.dbc, Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 18 (SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS), EffectBasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = +5, EffectSpellClassMask [8192,0,0], which inside SpellFamilyName 28 selects Anomaly Spikes 503825 (ProcChance 8) and 504886; Effect[1] is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), EffectBasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = +20%, EffectSpellClassMask [134217728,0,0], which selects the launched Anomaly Spike 503826 only. 503826 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with DmgClass 1, so Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone consumes the damage modifier (Unit.cpp), and Aura::CalcProcChance consumes the chance modifier (SpellAuras.cpp). Both of Erasion's own halves are correct data on a correct core path. The chance half produces no observable spike today because Anomaly Spikes 503825 has ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so Aura::GetProcEffectMask never admits it and Aura::CalcProcChance is never reached; that missing proc entry belongs to Anomaly Spikes, not to Erasion, and is fixed under issue #852. This scenario guards Erasion's own contribution, which already works.
